limitations: The output is materialized and ledger-backed but remains unverified until a fresh independent Verifier completes.

representationEvidenceLimits.evidenceBoundary: These fixed checks establish bounded representation facts for the selected inputs; they do not establish general semantic equivalence, AI projection quality, or owner acceptance.
representationEvidenceLimits.originalMarkdown: The matcher associates the exact specification with heading/name and kind/API fragments. It does not require explicit namespace text in emitted markup; its trace to the full GraphKey relies on selected source and record scope.
representationEvidenceLimits.replacementMarkdown: The fixed check parses the emitted full metadata/specification and Schema representation against the selected inputs.
